description: Calculate a tropical Placidus natal chart, Big Three, positions and aspects from user-provided birth details. Resolve the city first. Ask for missing details; never guess birth time. Returns a chart here and an optional link to continue on Astral Code. Astrology is symbolic reflection, not a prediction of events.

birth_date.description: Local birth date, YYYY-MM-DD, between 1900 and today.

birth_time.description: Local clock time HH:MM. Omit when unknown; never guess.

timezone.description: IANA timezone from find_birth_locations, not a current UTC offset.

unknown_time.description: True when the user does not know their birth time. No Ascendant or houses will be returned.
